default_pattern_rule: For each route_uid and direction_id: prefer a pattern containing inside-FTZ stops, then any active 2025 service, then greatest stop count, then most trips in snapshot, then lexicographic pattern_uid.
pattern_definition: Group route_id + direction_id + shape_id + exact ordered stop_id sequence; time and pickup/dropoff differences are not separate display patterns. Example times/restrictions belong only to representative_trip_uid.
time_limit: This October 2025 published snapshot is not a whole-year route-change log. Active2025days reflect only the service calendar present in this feed. Representative example times are not a complete timetable.
distance_units: shape_dist_traveled_raw retains source numeric text; no unverified conversion to metres is made.
scope_limit: Outside-FTZ stops and geometry retained only to show the complete selected bus routes; they are not newly classified as FTZ members. This is scheduled network geometry, not passenger occupancy or live bus locations.
